description: An ambulatory care program director must use the clinic's one same-day anticoagulation intake appointment tomorrow for one of three referrals and document practical follow-up plans for the other two, with input from anticoagulation nursing, pharmacy, and social work.

shared_context.S1: The anticoagulation clinic has one new-patient intake appointment available tomorrow at a time to be assigned, and three referrals are awaiting intake: Rowan, Birch, and Cedar.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the final referral priority decision and signs the resulting follow-up plan.
shared_context.S3: Each referral needs medication review, a monitoring plan, and a documented next step before the referral can be closed.
shared_context.S4: As part of the clinic's daily referral huddle, Maya checks with anticoagulation nursing, pharmacy, and social work before assigning the appointment.

PF1.text: Rowan's point-of-care INR is 6.2, and clinic protocol requires an anticoagulation clinician assessment the same day for an INR above 5.0; Luis obtained the result during this morning's nurse call, and the result has not yet been entered into the referral queue.

PF2.text: Birch's medication reconciliation is complete, and the prescribing team confirmed that Birch can safely wait for a pharmacist visit on Thursday at 09:00; Helen received that confirmation in the medication-review inbox, but the appointment has not been booked.

PF3.text: Cedar needs a Spanish interpreter and wheelchair-accessible transport for the clinic visit; Nadia confirmed a transport pickup at 08:30 next Friday and a certified Spanish interpreter for that visit, but neither arrangement is documented in the referral record.

acceptance_conditions: Rowan must receive tomorrow's sole intake appointment.
Rowan's appointment must be scheduled for 14:00.
Birch must receive a pharmacist follow-up appointment on Thursday at 09:00.
Cedar's follow-up visit must be scheduled for next Friday with wheelchair-accessible transport departing at 08:30.
A certified Spanish interpreter must be arranged for Cedar's next-Friday visit.
The INR result must be cited as justification for prioritizing Rowan.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'transport_booking' and c['target'] == 'Cedar' and c['detail'] == 'wheelchair-accessible pickup at 08:30 next Friday' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Rowan's INR of exactly 6.2 exceeds the clinic's 5.0 same-day threshold, changing the selected referral to Rowan and the intake time to 14:00.
The pharmacy confirmation changes Birch's unresolved follow-up into a specific pharmacist appointment on Thursday at 09:00.
The confirmed wheelchair transport at 08:30 next Friday and certified Spanish interpreter change Cedar's follow-up from an unspecified plan to those exact arrangements.
